stimulus_bacaan:
This dialogue is for questions number 1 to 4 (Unit 1: Galang from Kalimantan)!
Galang : Good morning! Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Galang. I am from Class VII-A.
Andre : Good morning, Galang! Nice to meet you. I’m Andre from Class VII-B. Where are you from?
Galang : I’m from Kalimantan, and now I live on Jalan Belitung. What about you, Andre?
Andre : I’m from Surabaya, and I live at Jalan Merdeka No. 15. By the way, this is my classmate, Monita. (2) ...
hobby is reading science fiction novels.
Monita : Hi, Galang! Pleased to meet you. Oh, the school bell is ringing. We have to go to our classroom now.
See you at break time!
Galang : Pleased to meet you too, Monita. See you later!
teks_soal: [Analisis Konteks Sosial & Preposisi Alamat – HOTS] Why does Galang say "I live on Jalan Belitung" while Andre says "I live at Jalan Merdeka No. 15"?
pembahasan: on + nama jalan; at + alamat bernomor

opsi_jawaban.label: A
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because Galang forgets his street name in Kalimantan.

opsi_jawaban.label: B
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because "on" is used for a street name without a house number, whereas "at" is used for a specific address with a house number.

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because "on" is only used in the morning and "at" is used at night.

opsi_jawaban.label: D
opsi_jawaban.teks: Because Jalan Belitung is the name of a province, not a street.

Read Monita’s Secret Fried Rice Recipe below for questions number 17 to 25 (Unit 3: A Secret Recipe)!
Goal: How to Make Monita’s Special Homemade Fried Rice (Nasi Goreng Spesial)
Ingredients: 2 plates of cold cooked rice, 2 cloves of garlic, 3 shallots, 2 red chilies (optional), 1 egg, 50g diced
chicken breast, 2 tablespoons of sweet soy sauce (kecap manis), 1
2 teaspoon of salt, 2 tablespoons of cooking
oil, cucumber slices, and fried shallots.
Utensils: A mortar and pestle (cobek dan ulekan), a wok, a spatula, a knife, a cutting board, a stove, and two
serving plates.
Steps:
1. First, peel the garlic and shallots, then grind them together with the red chilies and salt using a mortar and
pestle until smooth.
2. Second, heat two tablespoons of cooking oil in a wok over medium heat.
3. Next, stir-fry the ground spice paste until fragrant, then push it to the side of the wok and crack the egg into
the pan. Scramble the egg and add the diced chicken until cooked.
4. Then, put the cold cooked rice into the wok and pour the sweet soy sauce over the rice.
5. After that, stir and toss everything evenly using a spatula for 3 minutes until the rice is well-coated and
smoky.
6. Finally, turn off the stove, transfer the fried rice onto serving plates, garnish with cucumber slices and fried
shallots, and serve warm!

opsi_jawaban.label: C
opsi_jawaban.teks: To slice the cucumber into thin circles

opsi_jawaban.teks: To boil water for making iced tea

smoky.

shallots, and serve warm!

stimulus_bacaan:
Read the Procedure Text on Sorting & Upcycling Household Rubbish below for questions number 17 to
25 (Unit 3: Let’s Clean Up!)!
Goal: How to Manage Household Waste Using the 3R Principle (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle)
Equipment: Three labeled bins: Green Bin (Organic Waste), Yellow Bin (Non-Organic Recyclables), and Red
Bin (Hazardous/B3 Waste), rubber gloves, and a compost bucket.
Steps:
1. First, wear rubber gloves to keep your hands clean and safe before handling household waste.
2. Second, collect all kitchen food scraps, vegetable stems, fruit peels, and dry garden leaves, then put them
into the Green Bin to be processed into organic garden compost.
3. Next, rinse and flatten empty plastic water bottles, shampoo bottles, aluminum cans, and cardboard boxes,
then place them into the Yellow Bin for the recycling bank (Bank Sampah).
4. Then, separate broken glass lamps, used batteries, and expired medicine bottles, and put them safely into
the Red Bin so they do not poison the soil or injure sanitation workers.
5. Finally, wash your hands with soap under running water and keep all bin lids closed tightly!

stimulus_bacaan:
Read the Invitation Card and Descriptive Text about the School Festival below for questions number 17
to 25 (Unit 2 & Unit 3: Extracurriculars & School Festival)!
Text A (Official Invitation Card):
To: Mr. and Mrs. Pratama (Parents of Galang Pratama – Class VII-A)
The Principal and Student Council (OSIS) of SMP Merdeka cordially invite you to attend the Grand Opening
of SMP Merdeka Art, Science & Extracurricular Festival 2026 on Saturday, May 16th, 2026, at 08.00 a.m.
in the SMP Merdeka Main Hall. Your presence will greatly encourage our students’ creativity!
RSVP: OSIS Secretary (Sinta – 0813-4567-8900) before May 14th.
Text B (Galang’s Description of the Festival):
Our School Festival last Saturday was super lively! Every class and extracurricular club set up a decorated
booth around the courtyard. The Science Club demonstrated a solar-powered water filter, while the Painting
Club displayed thirty student artworks in the gallery. At 10.00 a.m., Pipit and I performed a double-staff Pencak
Silat routine on the main stage. Everyone clapped enthusiastically!
